premise: Badger digs for treasure and finds a shiny pebble (for Raccoon), a sweet clover (for Rabbit) and a lot of earth on his own nose — which makes everyone laugh, the best treasure of all.
inspiration: The Farmer and His Sons (Aesop), where the treasure in the field is the digging itself; turned: Badger gives away everything he finds and ends up richest in friends and laughter.
lesson: Giving and laughing together is its own treasure.

en-US.title: Badger Digs for Treasure
en-US.text: {badger:enter} Badger was digging for treasure. [excited] Real treasure! {badger:face happy} {badger:live} {sfx:dig} He dug a hole, and out came… {badger:face surprised} a shiny pebble. {raccoon:enter} Raccoon came running. [gasps] Ooh, shiny! {raccoon:hop x2} Badger looked at the pebble. He looked at Raccoon. {badger:face happy} [softly] Here, he said. It's yours. {raccoon:hearts} {badger:live} Badger dug another hole, and out came… a sweet little clover. {rabbit:enter} Rabbit came hopping over to see. {rabbit:live} His ears shot up. Clover! So Badger gave him that too. {badger:face sad} Now he had no treasure at all. [sighs] One more hole, he said. {raccoon:live hold} I won't peek! said Raccoon, paws over his eyes. {badger:live} Badger dug and dug, deeper and deeper… and {sfx:pop} popped up with earth all over his nose. {raccoon:live resume} Raccoon peeked. [laughs] {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:wobble x2} Rabbit laughed. {raccoon:face happy} Raccoon laughed. {badger:face happy} {badger:wobble x2} And Badger laughed hardest of all. [happily] Did you find any treasure? asked Rabbit. Badger wiped his nose and smiled. Plenty.

es-ES.title: Tejón busca un tesoro
es-ES.text: {badger:enter} Tejón estaba buscando un tesoro. [excited] ¡Un tesoro de verdad! {badger:face happy} {badger:live} {sfx:dig} Cavó un agujero, y salió… {badger:face surprised} una piedrecita brillante. {raccoon:enter} Mapache llegó corriendo. [gasps] ¡Ooh, cómo brilla! {raccoon:hop x2} Tejón miró la piedrecita. Miró a Mapache. {badger:face happy} [softly] Toma, le dijo. Para ti. {raccoon:hearts} {badger:live} Tejón cavó otro agujero, y salió… un trébol tierno y dulce. {rabbit:enter} Conejo se acercó dando saltitos a mirar. {rabbit:live} Levantó las orejas. ¡Trébol! Y Tejón se lo dio también. {badger:face sad} Ahora ya no le quedaba ningún tesoro. [sighs] Un agujero más, dijo. {raccoon:live hold} ¡No miro! dijo Mapache, tapándose los ojos. {badger:live} Tejón cavó y cavó, más y más hondo… y {sfx:pop} asomó con el hocico lleno de tierra. {raccoon:live resume} Mapache miró. [laughs] {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:wobble x2} Conejo se echó a reír. {raccoon:face happy} Mapache se echó a reír. {badger:face happy} {badger:wobble x2} Y Tejón se rió más que nadie. [happily] ¿Encontraste algún tesoro? preguntó Conejo. Tejón se limpió el hocico y sonrió. Muchísimos.

dig.prompt: small paws scrabbling and digging quickly in soft earth, close, realistic

pop.prompt: a soft comic pop, like a little head popping out of the ground, playful
